name: E2E core 1305: vague ask then cost
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'how's my agent doing?'. Once Langy has answered, write exactly: 'I mean cost'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: On turn 1, Langy gave a concrete metric without asking 'which one?'.
On turn 2, Langy returned a cost figure (or 'no data') without asking the user to clarify the time range.
